findings.title: Test does not pin that refusal reason is hidden
findings.problem: test_unavailable_catalog_entry_message_hides_id_and_reason asserts only that the catalogue id is absent and that 'Choose another MCP server' is present. It never asserts that 'not found', 'inactive' or 'not public' are absent from the message, nor that the exact reason reaches logger.warning. All other converted tests match only the shared phrase 'not available in the catalogue', so none distinguishes the three states.
findings.impact: The spec requirement that users cannot probe which catalogue entries exist (reason logged only) is a security property of the change. If the message is reverted to include the reason, for example '(inactive)', no test fails. Source is currently correct (reason chosen at access_control.py:130-135, logged at line 139, not in the raised message).
findings.recommendation: In the test, assert none of 'not found', 'inactive', 'not public' appears in str(exc.value) for each of the three entry states, and patch codemie.service.mcp.access_control.logger (as test_logged_server_name_cannot_forge_log_lines does) to assert the exact reason reaches logger.warning.
